summary: Onboard LabelWise data-labeling SaaS: burst-seat pool, VPC connector, KMS entitlements
description:
Issue summary:
Requester (Research Data Team) has selected LabelWise (third-party data-labeling SaaS) for a 6-week pilot to support QA labeling work for two RLHF projects. Request includes 30 permanent seats + a burst pool of up to 100 ephemeral seats for intensive sprints, VPC egress connector for private dataset uploads, and KMS integration for customer-managed keys.

Impact:
- Research and Ops teams cannot start pilot until SCIM/Okta provisioning, billing cost-center mapping, and KMS entitlements are approved.
- Pilot timeline: target start 2026-03-22. Delays will push downstream evals and slow RLHF loop.

Environment:
- SaaS service (LabelWise) hosted in us-east region; will require VPC egress configuration and private S3 ingest.

Acceptance criteria / Deliverables:
1) Completed vendor security questionnaire and SOC2/PCI attestations ingested into vendor vault.
2) Finance approval for ephemeral-seat billing model and cost-center tagging.
3) Procurement PO or contract signature for 6-week pilot term.
4) SCIM/Okta provisioning configured and tested with 30 default seats + burst pool gating rules.
5) KMS entitlements validated and playbook for rotating keys documented.

Steps to onboard (initial):
1. Run security review with Security Ops (link above).
2. Contract & SOW review with Legal; confirm data residency & liability terms.
3. Finance to confirm rate/overage billing for ephemeral seats and set billing account (cost center 6201-ML-Research).
4. Create procurement request and generate PO.
5. Coordinate SCIM mapping and test Okta provisioning against staging LabelWise tenant.
6. Configure VPC egress connector and validate S3 presigned-upload flow.
7. Test KMS CMK integration in a sandbox.

Notes: LabelWise requires a minimum enterprise SLA addendum for burst-seat overages; contract team flagged a clause requiring 90 days notice for seat reductions (Legal input required).

investigation_notes: Security review: Vendor SOC2 Type II available but scoping note: SOC report excludes subcontractor that handles data uploads; follow-up required.
KMS: Vendor claims support for external CMKs via AWS KMS asymmetric keys; need to validate with sandbox account. Marco to provision test CMK in staging and run upload flow.
SCIM/Okta: LabelWise supports SCIM v2.0; mapping of role attributes (labeler, reviewer, admin) must align with our groups. Need to confirm attribute names for mapping and deprovisioning behavior.

Billing: Vendor invoices monthly with gross seat count + ephemeral overage line item. Finance requests a cap/alert to prevent runaway costs. Procurement to negotiate notification thresholds and maximum overage amount for pilot.
Network: VPC egress uses a vendor-managed NAT IP list. Security prefers a connector with private-link or static IPs; vendor currently supports static egress IP pool for enterprise customers only.
resolution: (in progress) Security requested vendor KMS whitepaper on 2026-03-11; vendor replied on 2026-03-12 with initial docs. Marco to validate in sandbox by 2026-03-14.
Legal provided redlines 2026-03-11; vendor counsel acknowledged and requested minor edits. Awaiting signed SOW after PO is issued.
Finance asked for PO estimate — requester supplied usage CSV 2026-03-12. Sienna to submit PO request by 2026-03-13 and set temporary overage cap of $2,500 for pilot pending finance approval.

Marco to validate KMS flow in staging and report results (due 2026-03-14).
